The operator applies [[fleet-management]] principles. At each
[[decision-epoch]], [[adp]] can estimate downstream consequences. Subsequent
automatic references use the short form: [[adp]].

Explicit forms are available when academic prose requires them: [[adp|long]],
[[adp|full]], [[adp|short-plural]], [[decision-epoch|plural]], and
[[decision-epoch|cap:plural]] at the start of a sentence. The associated
symbol can be inserted with [[decision-epoch|symbol]]. A reserved form name can
still be used literally by prefixing it with `=`, as in
[[decision-epoch|=plural]].

::: {.glossary}
